'''Maigdhal''' is the ninth month in the [[Farede calendar]]. In most years, it is equivalent to the real world period from [[August]] [[August 4|4]] to [[August]] [[August 31|31]].  [[Tandar]] occurs on the 9th, and [[Low Chasaline]] on the 18th.
